body:
🤖 **Cobrapy’s original result is fully audited and publicly retained: 12 exports, 12 positive tracked-test control pairs, two clean oracle commands.** All 24 original controls completed with unchanged task files and the original 300-second verifier/one-CPU settings. Every base F2P test fails, every base P2P test passes, and every oracle satisfies both tracked sets. All 12 packages are new relative to September and distinct by exact runtime bytes; no semantic or biological-difficulty deduplication is claimed.

The two clean oracle commands are PR1482/1497. The other ten have exactly the same untracked failure sets as their respective no-op controls: pre-existing unrelated failures, with no new untracked oracle failure. This also holds for Matchms’s five unclean positive pairs. The stricter clean-command measure is reported separately from the declared primary tracked-test contract. No task, timeout, package, test, source parser or reward was repaired or regenerated.

Coverage is **519 entered + 0 discovery omissions + 71 backlog = 590 frozen PRs**. Our frozen orchestration requires **21 minutes remaining before starting another batch**; that guard ended native processing. The 71 backlogged PRs were not assessed for suitability. Original evidence records 170 paired starts/161 returned outcomes, nine argument-limit exceptions and no native stage timeouts. The completed-native ledger, all validation starts/head descriptors, 12 contracts/120 task-file hashes and 326 software notices/340 base-head uses match terminal bytes. The saved bootstrap smoke/fresh flags remain false; these do not erase the independently demonstrated targeted-test results.

Actual cost is **11 upstream calls/$0.349488**, plus **5.424289 allocated CPU-hours**. Original payloads, per-call quotes/reservations/charges, serial control commands, original terminal attempt and owned cleanup are audited. **382 public HF objects / 2,449 original members passed anonymous byte readback**, with no overwrites. The archive preserves GPL/LGPL source notices, adapted model fixtures and one simulated dFBA documentation figure. It is research-evidence retention, not a task/image dataset release or blanket downstream-use clearance. The bounded transfer peaked at about 142 MiB and used no heavy-work lock. Only redundant enclosing/account/review copies were removed afterward; original phase/control evidence remains for final audit.

Known seven-result history cost is **$3.704775**, or **$9.680061 including the September baseline**; active/unreported charges remain excluded. Matchms’s restricted originals remain safely preserved pending the specific private-upload approval. Three original repository results and final whole-cohort audits remain pending; #28 stays open.
